title: 第九章 瘟霾遮四野 仁心救苍生第十章 妖风袭古道 月神遭重创

辞却战痕之地，四人并肩前行，循天地气机，一路梳理时序，滋养草木，肃清余魔。何年居前探路，运转时序大道察天地异象；花月初伴其侧，以草木灵息辨山川气脉；何日殿后，骄阳神力外放，震慑潜藏邪祟；何月居中，月华流转，调和周身气机，一路祥和，步履从容。
行不过两日，天地气机骤变。
本应清朗的天色，渐被一层灰蒙瘴气笼罩，日光黯淡，月华难透，山风掠过，再无草木清芬，反倒裹挟着一股腐朽腥臭之气，刺鼻难闻。
放眼望去，沿途草木渐次枯萎，枝叶泛黄凋落，生机尽失，不复往日葱郁；田间庄稼尽数枯死，颗粒无收；村落寂寥，不闻鸡鸣犬吠，不见炊烟袅袅，反倒处处透着死寂，一派凄凉萧瑟之象。
四人驻足，神色皆沉，心头覆上一层阴霾。
何日眉头紧锁，望着周遭死寂景象，沉声喝道：“此乃何等异象？比之魔氛更显凄烈，草木枯死，村落无人，实在诡异！”
何月缓步上前，指尖轻触身旁枯木，只觉一股阴寒歹毒之气，顺着指尖蔓延，连忙收敛月华之力，蹙眉柔声道：“此非寻常魔气，乃阴浊瘟毒之气，歹毒异常，侵草木、害生灵，所过之处，生机断绝，故而万物凋零，村落死寂。”
花月初神色凝重，周身草木灵息缓缓运转，抵御周遭瘟毒，眸光望向远处村落，柔声叹道：“此乃人间大疫，瘟毒肆虐，侵染生灵血脉，夺其生机，毁其气脉。天地时序崩坏，魔界趁机遣瘟魔下界，散播瘟毒，祸乱苍生，欲彻底摧毁三界生机，令天地沦为炼狱。”
何年闭目，运转《六千字文》时序大道，感知周遭气机，瘟毒弥漫，阴寒蚀骨，生灵哀嚎之念，隔着层层瘴气，依旧能清晰感知，心头骤紧，沉声道：“瘟毒已蔓延数十里，波及无数村落，苍生罹难，生灵涂炭。此乃魔界歹毒之计，不费一兵一卒，便可覆灭苍生，乱天地生机根基。”
“我等身负救世天命，遇此浩劫，绝不能坐视不理。当即刻深入疫区，寻瘟毒源头，击退幕后瘟魔，再以大道之力，化解瘟毒，救治苍生，梳理生机，绝不能让瘟毒继续蔓延，祸及更多生灵！”
花月初颔首，眸中满是慈悲：“兄长所言极是。吾掌草木生灵之道，最擅滋生气机、化解阴毒，可与阿姐月华之力相融，净化瘟毒，救治受难生灵；何日骄阳至刚之力，可灼烧瘟毒瘴气，震慑邪祟；兄长时序大道，可回溯生灵生机，稳固气脉，你我四人合力，定能遏止瘟疫，挫其凶焰。”
何月柔声附和：“瘟毒阴邪，至柔至阴，需以阳刚破之，以清和化之，以生机养之。我等大道互补，各司其职，必能救苍生于水火，复山川之生机。”
何日亦是义愤填膺，周身金光暴涨：“这瘟魔实在歹毒，残害无辜生灵，我定要将其重创打退，化解这场瘟疫，护天下百姓！”
心意既定，四人不再迟疑，催动神力，抵御周身瘟毒瘴气，朝着瘟疫最盛、怨气最浓的村落腹地缓步前行。
越往深处，瘟霾愈重，灰蒙瘴气遮天蔽日，腐朽之气愈发浓烈。沿途可见村落屋舍破败，街巷空寂，百姓卧于家中，面色青黑，气若游丝，周身萦绕着淡淡瘟毒，痛苦**，哀嚎之声不绝于耳，闻之令人心碎。
孩童啼哭，老者**，壮年倒地，家家户户，皆遭瘟毒侵袭，无一人幸免，满目皆是疮痍，遍地尽是悲凉，天地间，尽是绝望之气。
四人见此惨状，皆是心头震颤，悲悯之意涌上心头。
何年紧握双拳，眸中满是沉痛，朗声念诵《六千字文》仁善经文：“大道之行，天下为公，心怀悲悯，护养生灵，时序有序，生机不绝……”
花月初眼眶微润，轻声叹道：“苍生何辜，遭此浩劫。我等今日，定要倾尽所能，化解瘟毒，救治百姓，绝不辜负一身修为，不负天命所托。”

当下，四人分兵协作，各司其职，展开救治。
何日纵身跃起，周身骄阳神力尽数爆发，化作漫天金色光雨，洒落四野。骄阳乃至阳至刚之力，专克阴邪瘟毒，光雨所过之处，弥漫的瘟霾瘴气，渐渐消散，腐朽腥臭之气，被尽数净化，周遭天地，渐复清朗。
他以骄阳神力，灼烧空中游离的瘟毒，阻断瘟毒蔓延之路，为救治苍生，扫清外围障碍。金光所至，阴邪退散，瘟霾渐消，天地重见微光。
何月立于村落中央，双手结印，月华之力如水般弥漫开来，化作温润银辉，笼罩整座村落。月华清和，可调和阴阳，安抚神魂，化解阴毒，舒缓痛楚。
银辉洒落，卧病在床的百姓，脸上痛苦之色渐缓，**之声渐息，体内肆虐的瘟毒，被月华之力缓缓压制，不再肆意侵蚀身躯，紊乱的气机，渐渐平复，绝望的心神，得到安抚。
花月初缓步穿行街巷，草木灵诀全力施展，引动天地间残存的草木生机，化作点点绿色灵光，融入百姓体内。她指尖轻扬，山间残存的灵草仙草之气，被尽数引来，化作疗伤解毒之灵韵，滋养百姓受损的身躯，修复被瘟毒侵蚀的经脉，重铸生机。
她又寻得村中清泉，以草木灵法净化水质，融入灵韵，令百姓饮下，从内化解体内瘟毒，滋养五脏六腑，一点点恢复生机。
何年居于核心，怀捧《六千字文》玉简，全心运转时序大道。时序主岁月轮回，生死枯荣，他以自身神力为引，以天篆经文为纽带，催动时序回溯之力，稳住百姓体内生机脉络，延缓瘟毒侵蚀，护住最后一丝生机，再配合花月初草木生机之力，助受损身躯重焕生机。
他以时序之力，梳理周遭紊乱的天地气机，让枯败的草木，重获生机时序，令天地阴阳，渐渐回归有序，从根源上，瓦解瘟毒滋生的环境。
四人各司其职，通力协作，骄阳破瘟霾，月华安神魂，草木滋生机，时序固气脉，四道神力交织，化作漫天祥和光雾，笼罩整座村落。
不过半日，村中瘟霾散尽，空气重归清新，百姓体内瘟毒，被尽数化解，面色渐渐红润，气息趋于平稳，痛苦尽消，纷纷起身，对着四人跪地叩谢，感恩戴德。
“多谢仙人搭救，多谢仙人活命之恩！”

Leaving behind the battle scars, the four of them walked forward side by side, following the qi of heaven and earth, sorting out the time sequence along the way, nourishing the vegetation, and eliminating the remaining demons. When he is in the front, he explores the road, and runs the time-sequential avenue to observe the strange phenomena of the heaven and earth; when he is at the beginning of the month, he is beside him, and he uses the breath of grass and trees to identify the energy of mountains and rivers; when he is behind the palace, the scorching sun's power is released, frightening the hidden evil spirits; when he is in the middle, the moonlight flows, harmonizing the qi of the whole body, making the journey peaceful, and walking calmly.
After only two days of traveling, the energy of heaven and earth suddenly changed.
The sky that should have been clear and clear gradually became shrouded in a layer of gray miasma, the sunlight was dim, the moonlight was difficult to penetrate, and the mountain wind passed by. Instead of the fresh fragrance of grass and trees, it was enveloped with a rotten and fishy smell, which was pungent and unpleasant.
Looking around, the vegetation along the way is gradually withering, the branches and leaves are turning yellow and falling, all vitality is lost, and they are no longer as lush as before; the crops in the fields are all dead and there is no harvest; the villages are lonely, with no chickens crowing, dogs barking, and no smoke curling up. Instead, there is a dead silence everywhere, making it look desolate and desolate.
The four of them stopped, their expressions gloomy, and their hearts were filled with a layer of gloom.
He Ri frowned, looking at the deathly scene around him, and shouted in a deep voice: "What kind of vision is this? It is even more miserable than the demonic atmosphere. The vegetation is dead and the villages are deserted. It is really weird!"
He Yue slowly stepped forward and touched the dead wood beside her with her fingertips. She felt a cold and vicious aura spreading along her fingertips. She quickly gathered the power of the moonlight and said softly with a frown, "This extraordinary demonic aura is a turbid and poisonous aura. It is extremely vicious and invades vegetation and harms living creatures. Wherever it passes, life is cut off. Therefore, everything withers and the village is dead."
Hua Yue's expression was solemn, and the spiritual energy of the vegetation around her body was slowly moving to resist the surrounding plague. She looked at the distant villages and sighed softly: "This is a great plague in the world. The plague is raging, infecting the blood of living beings, taking away their vitality, and destroying their Qi. The time order of heaven and earth has collapsed. The demon world took the opportunity to send the plague demon down to spread the plague and bring disaster to the people. It wants to completely destroy the vitality of the three realms and turn the world into purgatory."
He Nian closed his eyes, running the time sequence of "Six Thousand Character Essay", and sensed the qi around him. The plague was permeating the air, the cold was corroding the bones, and the thoughts of the living beings were wailing. Through the layers of miasma, he could still clearly sense it, and his heart suddenly tightened. He said in a deep voice: "The plague has spread for dozens of miles and affected countless villages. People have been killed and lives have been destroyed. This is a vicious plan of the devil world. It can destroy the people without even using a single soldier and disrupt the vitality of the world."
"We have the destiny to save the world, and we must not sit idly by when encountering this catastrophe. We should immediately go deep into the epidemic area, find the source of the plague, repel the plague behind the scenes, and then use the power of the great road to dissolve the plague, save the people, and sort out life. We must not allow the plague to continue to spread and harm more living beings!"
Hua Yue nodded, her eyes full of compassion: "What brother said is absolutely true. I control the way of vegetation and creatures, and I am best at cultivating vitality and resolving evil poisons. I can blend it with the power of my sister's moonlight to purify plague poisons and save suffering creatures. Spirit; when will the scorching sun be so powerful that it can burn away the miasma of plague and deter evil spirits? Brother, the path of time can trace back the vitality of living beings and stabilize the Qi veins. The four of you and I can surely stop the plague and dampen its ferocious flames. "
He Yue echoed in a soft voice: "The plague poison is yin and evil, from soft to yin. It needs to be broken with masculinity, transformed with purity and harmony, and nourished with vitality. Our great avenues complement each other and each performs its own duties. We will be able to save the people from water and fire and restore the vitality of mountains and rivers."
He Ri was also filled with righteous indignation, and the golden light around his body skyrocketed: "This plague demon is really vicious and harms innocent creatures. I will defeat it severely, resolve this plague, and protect the people of the world!"
With their minds made up, the four of them no longer hesitated, activated their divine power, resisted the plague and miasma around them, and walked slowly towards the hinterland of the village where the plague was most prevalent and resentment was strongest.
The deeper you go, the heavier the plague becomes, the gray miasma blocks the sky and the sun, and the rotten atmosphere becomes stronger. Along the way, you can see dilapidated houses in villages, empty streets and alleys, and people lying in their homes, with blue and black faces, breathless, faint poison lingering around them, pain and pain, and the sound of wailing is endless, which is heartbreaking to hear.
Children cry, old men die, young men fall to the ground, every familyEvery household was attacked by the plague, and no one was spared. There was devastation everywhere, the land was filled with desolation, and the world was filled with despair.
When the four people saw this tragic situation, their hearts trembled, and compassion surged into their hearts.
He Nian clenched his fists, his eyes full of pain, and recited aloud the benevolent verses of "The Six Thousand Character Essay": "On the journey of the great road, the world is for the common good, with compassion in mind, to protect living beings, in an orderly manner, with endless vitality..."
Hua Chuu's eyes were slightly moist, and she sighed softly: "How can the common people deserve this catastrophe. Today, we will do our best to defuse the plague and save the people. We will never let down our cultivation and live up to the destiny entrusted to us by fate."
At the moment, the four people divided their forces and cooperated, each performing his own duties, to carry out treatment.
Heri jumped up, and all the divine power of the scorching sun exploded around him, turning into a rain of golden light that filled the sky and scattered everywhere. The scorching sun and even the most powerful power of the Yang can specifically defeat the poison of Yin evil and plague. Wherever the light and rain passes, the pervasive plague and miasma gradually dissipates. The rotten and stinky atmosphere is completely purified, and the surrounding heaven and earth gradually become clear again.
He used the power of the scorching sun to burn the plague floating in the air, blocking the spread of the plague, and clearing peripheral obstacles to save the people. Wherever the golden light reaches, the evil spirits dissipate, the haze gradually disappears, and the heaven and earth see the light again.
He Yue stood in the center of the village, forming seals with his hands. The power of the moonlight spread like water, turning into a warm silver glow, covering the entire village. The clear moonlight can reconcile yin and yang, soothe the soul, resolve yin poison, and relieve pain.
The silver light fell, and the pain on the faces of the people who were bedridden gradually eased, the sounds of sexual intercourse gradually subsided, the plague raging in the body was slowly suppressed by the power of the moonlight, and no longer eroded the body wantonly, the disordered energy gradually calmed down, and the desperate mind was soothed.
At the beginning of the month, Hua Chu walked slowly through the streets, and the grass and trees spirit technique was used with all its strength, activating the remaining vegetation vitality between heaven and earth, turning it into little green auras, and integrating into the people's bodies. She flicked her fingertips, and all the remaining spiritual grass and fairy grass in the mountains were attracted, and turned into the aura of healing and detoxification, nourishing the damaged bodies of the people, repairing the meridians eroded by the plague, and rebuilding vitality.
She also found a clear spring in the village, purified the water with the spiritual methods of plants and trees, and blended it with the aura. She asked the people to drink it, which would dissolve the poison in the body from the inside, nourish the internal organs, and restore vitality little by little.
He Nian is at the core, holding the jade slips of the "Six Thousand Character Essay" in his arms, and wholeheartedly running the path of time sequence. The time master controls the reincarnation of time, life, death and prosperity. He uses his own divine power as a guide and the Tianzhuan scriptures as a link to activate the power of time sequence retrospection to stabilize the vitality veins in the people's bodies, delay the erosion of the plague, protect the last trace of vitality, and cooperate with the vitality power of the flowers and trees at the beginning of the month to help the damaged body regain its vitality.
He used the power of time order to sort out the chaotic qi of the surrounding heaven and earth, allowing the withered vegetation to regain the order of life, and gradually returning the yin and yang of the world to order, and fundamentally dismantling the environment where plagues breed.
The four people each perform their duties and work together. The scorching sun breaks through the plague and haze, the moonlight calms the soul, the vegetation breeds vitality, and the timing strengthens the Qi veins. The four divine powers are intertwined, turning into a peaceful light mist that fills the sky and envelopes the entire village.
Within half a day, the plague haze in the village dissipated, the air returned to freshness, and all the plague poisons in the people's bodies were eliminated. Their faces gradually became rosy, their breathing stabilized, and their pain disappeared. They stood up one after another, knelt down and knelt down to the four people to express their gratitude.
"Thank you to the immortal for saving me, and thank you to the immortal for keeping me alive!"
